verdict.rationale: Marqeta supports background automation primitives — webhooks fire on events, JIT funding lets a merchant's own system autonomously approve/deny funding requests via business rules, and velocity/authorization controls enforce spend rules automatically without human intervention. The MCP server also lets AI agents query data and issue cards programmatically. However there is no evidence of a dedicated 'automation builder' or persistent background agent/scheduler framework designed for AI-native users to configure ongoing autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: a first-class automation/workflow scheduler, evidence of persistent autonomous agent execution, and independent confirmation of these automations running unattended in production.
